annotations.title: Investors: save a startup pitch to your PitchSpark saved pitches

description: Investors: save one pitch (by pitch_id) to your PitchSpark saved pitches (status watching, already_watching or limit_reached). The founders are not contacted; the save counts as anonymous interest in their pitch statistics. Needs an API key from an investor account (self-declared; PitchSpark does not verify accreditation) or OAuth watchlist:write.
name: pitchspark_watch_pitch_v1
